reason: A is more mechanistically substantive and testable: it couples local chemistry and Mn-related magnetic frustration to SFE, dislocation dissociation, hcp nucleation, and a directional strain-hardening prediction, whereas B largely restates the generic composition–SFE–TWIP/TRIP concept and predicts only “altered” properties.
